selection_rule: Validation macro-F1 highest; ties broken by balanced accuracy, directional macro-F1, then lower log loss. No test data used.

logistic_regression.preprocessing: median imputation and StandardScaler fitted within train-only sklearn pipeline

xgboost.class_imbalance: compute_sample_weight balanced from train labels only

hist_gradient_boosting.class_imbalance: compute_sample_weight balanced from train labels only

rsi_baseline.rule: RSI <= 30 predicts UP; RSI >= 70 predicts DOWN; otherwise NEUTRAL. Fixed, untuned rule.
